name: ServiceM8
description: Job cards, the schedule, quotes and invoices on site, signatures, photos, and PDF forms, on an iPhone or iPad, with accounting sync. Aimed at contractors with 1 to 20 people. Australia. Founded 2010. Kim Ford is the CEO.

mentions.evidence: GetLatka estimates about $2.6 million a year as of July 2025, with 24 employees. The company has not published revenue, and the estimate is a rough model. The homepage says the product is used to manage more than $35 billion in jobs, and that businesses complete 30 percent more work in the first 3 months. The pricing page says more than $50 billion in jobs. Those two job totals do not match, and neither is ServiceM8's revenue.
mentions.indieAngle: Self-serve onboarding and the app store, without a sales team, for a trade.

whyItPrints: A small contractor uses it every day to get paid. Self-serve, and a small team for the reach they claim.
